convergedLanesPurpose: Lanes that no longer call a Graph send endpoint directly because their delivery was routed to the shared boundary. They are recorded rather than deleted: each still owns its own recipient, opt-out, cancellation, and audit decisions, and losing that record would make the boundary look like the only thing guarding a send.
mailboxCapableSurfacesPurpose: Task 7E. sendSurfaces answers 'what can send'. This section answers the wider question the certification program actually needs: what can touch the mailbox AT ALL - read, write, delete, or send. A send-only inventory cannot see a destructive mailbox call or an unrouted mailbox read, and both are effects a zero-effect certification run must not cause. Counts are derived by AST from Graph /me/ URLs; a module whose URL is assembled by concatenation is undercounted here, which is why sendCapableByName exists alongside the counts.
